## The task or question

What should this experiment do or measure?

## A concrete example

What do you do today? Use public or synthetic data only.

## Success criterion

What result would make this useful, and what baseline should it beat?

## Evidence and uncertainties

Link any relevant run, benchmark or small reproduction. Separate observations from hypotheses.
